# V2.3 environment

`env/venv` and `env/wheelhouse` reuse the byte-tested V2 Python 3.11.13 CUDA 12.8 environment and offline wheelhouse through persistent symlinks. Exact package versions and the source lock SHA256 are recorded in `manifests/environment_manifest_prestage.json` and, after Stage C, `manifests/environment_manifest.json`.
